integrity: A self-contained exact-rational checker and an analytic infinite-size tail argument support the theorem. The independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-size result proves an intermediate negative coefficient and eventual recovery, not a full zero count for every mesh. Exact positivity horizon is proved only at size six. Relevant full-text prior-coverage uncertainty is disclosed in REVIEW.md.
title: Reentrant Galerkin heat-kernel signs on periodic one-dimensional meshes
